title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00063 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:15: Cut tensioner joint. Significant wave height 1 m. R/d cutter
01:15 - 01:45: L/o tensioner joint
01:45 - 02:15: R/d multibowl RT and nt2 connector
02:15 - 03:00: Pulled riser Cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck. Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed riser onto elevator.
03:00 - 03:30: R/u cutting machine cut riser. Significant wave height 1m. R/d cutting machine.
03:30 - 03:45: L/o splash zone joint and upper pup.
03:45 - 04:15: Pulled riser Cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck. Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed riser onto elevator.
04:15 - 05:00: R/u cutting machine cut riser. Significant wave height 0,9m r/d cutting machine.
05:00 - 05:15: L/o riser joint
05:15 - 05:30: Pulled riser Cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck. Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed riser onto elevator. Riser out of splash zone at 05 30
05:30 - 07:00: R/u cutting machine cut riser r/d cutting machine
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT for pull, cut and l/o riser
07:15 - 07:45: L/o riser joint latched onto elevator pulled riser. Landed same onto elevator.
07:45 - 08:30: R/u cutting machine cut riser r/d cutting machine
08:30 - 08:45: L/o riser joint latch onto riser and pulled riser. Landed off riser onto elevator.
08:45 - 09:30: R/u cutting machine cut riser r/d cutting machine
09:30 - 09:45: L/o riser joint Pulled riser
09:45 - 10:15: Removed master bushing and POOH with riser L/o riser joint.
10:15 - 11:00: Installed hatches. Removed scaffolding. Meanwhile completed skidding checklists. End of report
